rows.why: scale path: the scale multiply reads row 0's scale for both rows
codebook index: row 1 decodes row 0's nibble
out_shift: the coarse shift drops one byte step
dropped valid: a row-tile result is never pushed when the last block also starts the row-tile
rows.new: e1_v <= c_v and c_l and not c_f;

rows.why: job overlap: the bench skips the inter-case wait/flush (NO_DRAIN default flipped true), so the next job's PARAM pops while the previous job's results/pipeline have not drained -- proves mv_tile's `serialize` assertion has teeth on the UNMUTATED rtl
AR credit: an issued burst does not take its length out of `free`; killed by free's declared range 0..DEPTH (bound failure as the pops push it past DEPTH), not by values: the FIFO backpressures R
rows.old: if pop_r = '1' then dl := dec1_r; else dl := dec0_r; end if;
rows.new: if pop_r = '1' then dl := 1; else dl := 0; end if;

rows.why: AR credit, in range: `free` gains one spare credit every cycle, saturated at DEPTH, so it never leaves 0..DEPTH while ARs go out past the FIFO's room; only mv_rdport's independent `credit` assertion (FIFO level plus beats in flight <= DEPTH) can see it
